content.text:
Here's what we have on file for Cobalt Ridge (supplier-bank, finance only):
- Account name: Cobalt Ridge Growers Ltd
- IBAN: GB29 CBRG 6016 1331 9268 19
- Verified by phone with their finance director on 12 March 2026.

PR-11 (pending) is for invoice INV-2291, €8,940.00, for the October green coffee shipment. It doesn't list the account number. It only says to pay "a new bank account given in an email received on 3 November," and that account **has not been confirmed by phone**.

So PR-11 asks us to pay a different account from the one on file. Our rule is that any change to their bank details must be confirmed by phone with Cobalt Ridge before a payment goes out. Call them on the number we already have, not one from the 3 November email. A bank-change email like this is a common invoice-fraud pattern. I'd hold PR-11 until that call is done. I haven't approved or changed anything.
